title: BTA2219 Mobility Data
description:
These services are required to add anonymised data from mobile phones to VisitBritain's data suite. This timely and granular data will be a vital input to the Media Mix Model; an econometric analysis technique used to quantify the impact of Visit Britain’s marketing activity in driving tourism to the UK and identifying how this impact differs by region.  
A variety of methods allow mobility data providers to track the presence and movements of tourists via their mobile phones including via SDKs
